about.title: Building and running backend systems end to end.
about.p1: I am Mohammed Hakim Awad Ajrah, a Laravel Backend Developer and DevOps Engineer with 2 years of hands-on professional experience in backend development, RESTful API development, server deployment, Linux administration, and production troubleshooting.
about.p2: I build and maintain Laravel applications, develop APIs, integrate third-party services, manage MySQL databases, configure Nginx and PHP-FPM, deploy applications to Linux servers, and troubleshoot complex production issues across the full stack.

philosophy.title: My Philosophy
philosophy.p1: I believe reliable software goes beyond writing code - it means owning the system all the way to production. My approach focuses on clean Laravel architecture backed by servers that are configured, monitored, and troubleshot with care.
philosophy.p2: Whether it's building a REST API, integrating a third-party service, or diagnosing a production outage, I prioritize practical solutions and clear communication between backend and frontend teams.

projects.title: Featured Projects
projects.desc: A showcase of my work building Laravel APIs, deploying production servers, and integrating backend systems with modern frontends.

more.title: Looking for more?
more.desc: I have worked on delivery platforms, admin systems, and Node.js integrations, alongside deploying and maintaining the Linux servers that run them. Let's discuss how my experience can help your project.

delivery.title: Laravel Delivery & Restaurant Platform
delivery.desc: Production Laravel platform for restaurant and delivery operations, with REST APIs for web and mobile covering restaurants, orders, carts, and multilingual product content, plus Firebase push notifications and AI-powered features.

nextjs.title: React / Next.js Web Application
nextjs.desc: React/Next.js frontend connected to Laravel APIs across separate domains, deployed with PM2 behind an Nginx reverse proxy, with CORS, environment configuration, and production troubleshooting.

admin.title: Laravel Administration & Business Systems
admin.desc: Laravel-based admin systems covering user and role management, CRUD modules, product and category management, localization, import/export, file handling, notifications, and queue-based background processing.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp / Node.js Integration
whatsapp.desc: Node.js service integrated with Laravel applications for WhatsApp-related functionality, including custom API endpoints and MySQL database integration between the two systems.

exp1.desc: Developed and maintained Laravel backend applications and RESTful APIs for web and mobile products. Implemented authentication, roles, permissions, queues, notifications, and third-party integrations including Firebase Cloud Messaging and SMTP. Deployed applications to Linux production servers, configuring Nginx, PHP-FPM, Supervisor, and PM2, and troubleshooting CORS, DNS, SMTP, database, and server configuration issues.
